scope: Complete ordinary OpenPGP ASCII armor grammar; packets and cleartext signatures excluded

requirements.decision: Use RFC 4648 Section 4 Standard Base64, ignore ASCII whitespace while parsing, reject nonalphabet data, and generate lines no longer than 76 characters.

requirements.normative: must not reject, should not generate
requirements.decision: Rfc9580 parsing reports absent, malformed, mismatched, and valid checksum states without checksum-only rejection; generation omits CRC-24 by default. RequireValidCrc24 and LegacyCrc24 are separately named application and legacy-interoperability policies.
Require an armor header line, bounded headers, blank separator, Base64 data, optional checksum, and matching armor tail before releasing a block.
Accept only MESSAGE, PUBLIC KEY BLOCK, PRIVATE KEY BLOCK, and SIGNATURE ordinary armor labels at line start, with only trailing horizontal whitespace, and require an exact matching tail.
Parse exact Key-colon-space-Value headers, preserve unknown valid headers, bound count and bytes, and reject malformed headers instead of heuristically recovering across ambiguous framing.
The generator emits no Version header implicitly; every generated header is supplied explicitly by the caller.
PGP SIGNED MESSAGE is rejected because cleartext signatures require dash escaping, canonical text hashing, Hash headers, and a nested signature armor block beyond ordinary armor parsing.
